findings.title: Settings capacities present sample values while storage state is unknown
findings.trigger: Initial native PW6 settings capture with an empty action plan and no ready storage details.
findings.observation: The visible device card says remaining 9.4 GB, the storage entry says used 2.1 GB, and the card says Wi-Fi connected. The owner's retained state has storage_ready=false, storage_details=null and storage_status_code=unknown. The connection reading has no corresponding Wi-Fi state declaration in this batch.
findings.bounded_conclusion: The storage capacity claims lack authoritative captured storage data and must use actual data or an honest unknown state. The Wi-Fi claim is also unsupported by the supplied connection evidence; the actual network condition and implementation cause are not established here.

limitations: All four current originals and all four required related references were freshly viewed with tools.view_image; no extra opens, processed images or prior visual verdicts were used.
PW6 has no independent exact reference. Related PW5 images supply base layout/behavior context only, with each native viewport retained.

Visible ordinary and selected glyph hierarchy was read directly, but exact typeface identity and numerical 500/700 weights were not measured. Those are scope limitations, not permanent reading_pending.
Dates with 01 and the 21:02 progress time were readable in current History. No unshown 00/01/02 fixture or all-title raw/full/compact stress coverage is invented.
Reader is menu-open. There is no closed-reader capture, required source-art/oracle pair or source border/caption ownership verdict in this assignment.

Empty action members for Search, History and Settings do not qualify operation execution. The Reader menu action record and visible result give no physical, hardware, hidden-hit-region, performance, sleep/wake or genuine live-reader-lease credit.
Identity, final-capture completion, mechanical assertions and fixtures do not confer full-round, clean-round or R2 acceptance.
